summary: Keep historical signature-verdict replay off ordinary replication exchanges

replay.detail: Ordinary judgment slices verify newly signed claims only and advance at most one dependency-requeue page. The existing paced signature worker drains historical verdicts after membership or dependency changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored-state changes.

rules.detail: Trust roots, signature validation and pending-verdict rules are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional restart or state reset is needed after deploying the updated binary.

manual.detail: Existing queued verdicts are resumed automatically by the paced signature worker.

recovery.detail: Durable queues and cursors retain unfinished work across cancellation or restart.
